data.value: Plaats voorlopige hitsounds op basis van zones op het speelveld.
data.comment: Tool catalog description for Hitsound Preview Helper. It assigns temporary hitsounds according to positional zones on the playfield. Preserve the established mapping term hitsound; provisional means preview/draft assignment, not permanent playback.

data.value: hitsound|voorbeeld|preview|tijdelijk|voorlopig|zone|sample|positie

data.name: MapCleaner_Description
data.value: Herstel bruikbare greenlines en snap desgewenst de mapinhoud opnieuw.
data.comment: Tool catalog description for Map Cleaner. Greenlines are inherited timing points that change slider velocity; resnapping realigns map content to timing or distance snap. Preserve osu! community terms greenline and resnap.

data.value: opschonen|greenline|green line|inherited timing point|resnap|objecten opnieuw snappen|samples
data.comment: Additional search terms for Map Cleaner. Separate terms with |. Greenline means an inherited timing point; resnap means realign objects to a snap grid. Keep canonical English search terms.

data.value: Combineer meerdere mapsets en los conflicten op tussen beatmaps, audio, afbeeldingen, storyboards en samples.
data.comment: Tool catalog description for Mapset Merger. A mapset is a collection of related beatmaps and assets; the tool combines mapsets and resolves conflicting files. Preserve beatmap, storyboard, and mapset as established mapping terms.

data.name: MetadataManager_Description
data.value: Bewerk metadata één keer en pas die toe op meerdere beatmaps.
data.comment: Tool catalog description for Metadata Manager. Metadata means artist, title, tags, colours, and related beatmap fields; edits can be applied to multiple beatmaps. Preserve beatmap as established terminology.

data.name: MetadataManager_SearchTerms
data.value: metadata|artiest|titel|tags|kleuren|colors|beatmapinformatie
data.comment: Additional search terms for Metadata Manager. Separate terms with |. Include metadata field names and both colour/color spellings; preserve canonical English terms.

data.name: PatternGallery_Description

data.value: Vermenigvuldig en tel waarden op bij timing-, object-, bookmark- en storyboardeigenschappen.
data.comment: Tool catalog description for Property Transformer. It applies multiplication and addition to numeric properties in timing points, hit objects, bookmarks, and storyboard data. Preserve storyboard and other file-format terminology.

data.name: RhythmGuide_Description
data.value: Maak een beatmap met hitcirkels op basis van het ritme in meerdere maps.
data.comment: Tool catalog description for Rhythm Guide. It creates hit circles in a new beatmap using rhythmic information from multiple source beatmaps. Preserve beatmap and map as established mapper terms.

data.name: Sliderator_Description

data.value: slider|completion|duur|lengte|velocity|SV|slider velocity
data.comment: Additional search terms for Slider Completionator. Separate terms with |. SV means slider velocity; include duration and path-length concepts while preserving canonical English terms.

data.name: SliderMerger_Description
data.value: Voeg geselecteerde sliders en hitcirkels samen tot één doorlopende slider.

data.value: Pas BPM aan en voeg redlines toe zodat geselecteerde markers op de snaprasterlijnen vallen.
data.comment: Tool catalog description for Timing Helper. BPM is beats per minute. Redlines are uninherited timing points; the tool adjusts timing so selected markers align to the beat snap grid. Preserve BPM and redline mapping terminology.

data.name: HitsoundStudio_ExportSummary
data.value: Sample-indices: {0}, samples: {1}, greenlines: {2}
data.comment: Detailed Hitsound Studio export result. {0} is the count of custom sample indices, {1} is the count of sample entries containing a valid sample, and {2} is the count of greenline changes. Preserve each numbered placeholder exactly once; these are counts, not formatted dates or decimal values.

data.name: HitsoundStudio_ImportSummary
data.value: Sample-indices: 0, samples: {0}, greenlines: 0
data.comment: Detailed Hitsound Studio import result. {0} is the count of distinct sample arguments found across imported samples; the import creates no sample indices or greenlines. Preserve {0} exactly once; this is an integer count.

data.name: HitsoundStudio_MidiSummary
data.value: Noten: {0}, volumewijzigingen: {1}
data.comment: Detailed Hitsound Studio MIDI export result. {0} is the number of exported notes and {1} is the number of timing points receiving a volume change (zero when that option is disabled). Preserve both numbered placeholders exactly once; they are integer counts.

data.name: QuickUndo_NoCurrentBeatmap
data.value: QuickUndo kon de huidige beatmap niet bepalen. Open een beatmap in osu! en controleer de instelling voor de huidige beatmap bij Voorkeuren.
data.comment: Warning shown when QuickUndo cannot identify the beatmap currently open in the osu! editor. The user can open a beatmap and verify current-beatmap discovery in Preferences. Keep QuickUndo and osu! unchanged; beatmap is established mapper vocabulary.

data.name: QuickUndo_NoBackup
data.value: Er is geen bewaarde niet-periodieke back-up om terug te zetten.
data.comment: Warning shown when QuickUndo finds no retained non-periodic backup for the current beatmap. Non-periodic distinguishes user-triggered backups from automatic periodic snapshots.

data.name: QuickUndo_Restored
data.value: De nieuwste niet-periodieke back-up is teruggezet.
data.comment: Success notification after QuickUndo restores the newest retained non-periodic backup. No placeholders. Keep backup terminology concise.

data.name: QuickRun_EditorUnavailable
data.value: QuickRun kon de huidige selectie in de osu!-editor niet bepalen.
data.comment: Warning shown when QuickRun cannot read the selected hit objects in the currently open osu! editor. Keep QuickRun and osu! unchanged.

data.name: QuickRun_CommandUnavailable
data.value: Er is geen QuickRun-opdracht beschikbaar voor het huidige scherm.
data.comment: Warning shown when the command configured for the current selection size cannot be found. QuickRun is a proper feature name and must remain unchanged.

data.name: QuickRun_NoObjectsSelected
data.value: Er zijn geen hitobjecten geselecteerd en er is geen QuickRun-opdracht ingesteld voor een lege selectie. Selecteer hitobjecten of stel de opdracht voor geen selectie in bij Voorkeuren.
data.comment: Warning shown when QuickRun has read the editor successfully, found zero selected hit objects, and no command is configured for that selection size. Tell the user to select objects or configure the empty-selection command. Keep QuickRun unchanged.

data.name: QuickRun_NamedCommandUnavailable
data.value: De ingestelde QuickRun-tool '{0}' is niet beschikbaar.
data.comment: Warning shown when the tool named in QuickRun settings is not in the command catalog. {0} is the canonical untranslated tool name; preserve this placeholder exactly once.

data.name: QuickRun_Failed
data.value: QuickRun kon de opdracht niet uitvoeren. Bekijk de foutdetails voor technische informatie.
data.comment: Error notification after a QuickRun command throws. Preserve technical exception information separately in the exception details; do not insert raw exception text here.

data.name: BetterSave_EditorUnavailable
data.value: BetterSave kon de huidige beatmap niet bepalen. Open een beatmap in osu! en controleer de instelling voor de huidige beatmap bij Voorkeuren.
data.comment: Warning shown when BetterSave cannot identify the beatmap currently open in the osu! editor. The user can open a beatmap and verify current-beatmap discovery in Preferences. Keep BetterSave and osu! unchanged.

data.name: BetterSave_Saved
data.value: De huidige beatmap is opgeslagen.
data.comment: Success notification after BetterSave writes the currently open beatmap. Keep beatmap as established mapper vocabulary.

data.name: BetterSave_Failed
data.value: BetterSave kon de huidige beatmap niet opslaan. Bekijk de foutdetails voor technische informatie.
data.comment: Error notification after BetterSave fails. Preserve the original exception in technical details; do not expose raw exception text as localized UI.

data.name: ToolExecution_Failed
data.value: De bewerking kon niet worden voltooid. Bekijk de foutdetails voor technische informatie.
data.comment: Generic error summary shown when an application tool throws an exception not mapped to a specific expected user-facing message. Technical exception details are available separately; do not include exception text in this string.

data.name: Workspace_MissingBeatmapTitle
data.value: Geselecteerde beatmap ontbreekt
data.comment: Notification title shown when a previously selected beatmap file no longer exists. Keep beatmap as established mapper vocabulary.

data.name: Workspace_MissingBeatmapMessage
data.value: Een van de geselecteerde beatmaps is niet gevonden. Selecteer het bestand opnieuw via Bestand > Beatmap openen.
data.comment: Notification shown when a selected beatmap file has disappeared. The menu command File > Open beatmap is a UI label and will be localized by the Desktop resource owner; this message names the action in plain text.

data.name: Workspace_OpenBeatmapPicker
data.value: Beatmap openen
data.comment: Title passed to the native beatmap file picker. This is user-visible dialog text and should use the natural imperative for opening one or more beatmap files.

data.name: Exception_OperationFailed
data.value: De bewerking kan niet worden uitgevoerd met de huidige invoer of programmastatus.
data.comment: Fallback user-facing message for recognized expected application exceptions when no more specific localized message exists. This describes invalid input or a prerequisite/state mismatch without exposing exception internals.

data.name: Exception_FileMissing
data.value: Een benodigd bestand of een benodigde map is niet gevonden. Controleer het geselecteerde pad en probeer het opnieuw.
data.comment: User-facing summary for FileNotFoundException or DirectoryNotFoundException. Do not include a path placeholder; the original path remains available in technical details.

data.name: Exception_LiveEditorUnavailable
data.value: Mapping Tools kon de livegegevens van de huidige beatmap niet lezen. Open de bedoelde beatmap in osu! en controleer de instelling voor livegegevens bij Voorkeuren.
data.comment: Actionable summary for LiveBeatmapUnavailableException, which covers disabled live reading, no readable active editor, a different beatmap being open, or unsafe live data. Keep Mapping Tools and osu! unchanged; do not expose the technical exception message.

data.name: Exception_BackupBeatmapMismatch
data.value: Deze back-up hoort bij een andere beatmap. Kies een back-up die bij de huidige beatmap hoort voordat je deze terugzet.
data.comment: Summary for BeatmapBackupIncompatibleException, raised when backup metadata does not match the destination difficulty or mapset. Do not include filenames; they remain in technical details.

data.name: Exception_AccessDenied
data.value: De toepassing heeft geen toegang tot het geselecteerde bestand of de geselecteerde map. Controleer de machtigingen en probeer het opnieuw.
data.comment: User-facing summary for UnauthorizedAccessException. Do not include a path placeholder; the original path and diagnostic message remain in technical details.

data.name: Exception_InvalidInput
data.value: Een of meer waarden zijn ongeldig. Controleer de invoer en probeer het opnieuw.
data.comment: User-facing summary for ArgumentException from an operation boundary. This is broad because exception text may be programmer-facing; preserve specific form validation in the owning UI.

data.name: Exception_Prerequisite
data.value: De bewerking kan in de huidige status niet doorgaan. Controleer de voorwaarden en probeer het opnieuw.
data.comment: User-facing summary for InvalidOperationException from an operation boundary. This covers unavailable editor state or unmet prerequisites without exposing diagnostic exception text.

data.name: Exception_UnexpectedFailure
data.value: Een onverwachte fout heeft de bewerking onderbroken. Bekijk de foutdetails voor technische informatie.
data.comment: Generic user-facing message for unexpected exceptions. Keep technical diagnostic detail in the separate exception field; never interpolate raw exception text here.
